question: On exactly the same original mule-deer GPS source-tag/year/date and same year-month, daily Tmax, astronomical daylength, prior 30-day P-ET0, does the positive observed q=NIGHT-DAY association arise from a negative DAY component, positive NIGHT component, or both?
original_provider_identity_policy: Re-fetch only frozen same 3 original GPS files with original provider UUID/size/MD5. All original full-source native GPS q/daylength mean+tag counts must replay before weather. Fresh ERA5 same source GPS-observed cell/date physical arrays MUST match previous original SHA256 fingerprints exactly. All six prior daily source weather model means+counts and nine previous source native year-month joint coefficients/tag counts must replay; if mismatch/HOLD, no new biological effect.
source_datetime_and_q_rule: Preserve the existing original one selected UTC-hourly fix per tag, 0.5–2h accepted GPS interval at <=60 km/h, endpoints and midpoint identical solar date and DAY/NIGHT part, at least three original steps per original tagged solar date in both DAY and NIGHT, at least ten q-qualified original dates per original tagged calendar year.
component_definition: For each SAME accepted source GPS tag/solar date, yDAY=log1p(median accepted DAY speed km/h), yNIGHT=log1p(median accepted NIGHT speed km/h), q=yNIGHT-yDAY. Reconstruct ALL original source tag/year/date q, local solar-daylength and cell from original source intervals and fail closed unless exact 1e-10 match to existing source_admitted_daily. No tag/date screening on movement values beyond original preexisting q observation eligibility.
exact_same_month_cohort: Use the old year-month joint q~Tmax+astronomical-daylength+prior30day P−ET0 eligibility, all three predictor rank/variance thresholds, >=5 original qualified days per month, >=0.05h daylight span/month, >=2 months/year, >=15 original qualified days/year, >=0.05 hours² within-month daylength centered Sxx, >=5 independent source tags. Qualify on previous q and weather support only; DAY and NIGHT contributions can NEVER be admitted independently or on their coefficient/sign.
primary_estimand: On SAME prior admitted original tag/year/month/weather dates, fit joint q~Tmax+L+W and separately DAY~Tmax+L+W and NIGHT~Tmax+L+W using within-tag-year-month centering. Equal eligible original tag-years per original tag and equal tags per source; 2000 paired source-tag bootstrap resamples used for all three, verifying b_q == b_NIGHT-b_DAY for each tag/year, tag and source, and bootstrap draws.
secondary_estimands: On exactly the same original tags/months/dates, fit the three component coefficients with no month demeaning but same L and W controls and test paired month-minus-raw changes, including source day and night components. Report all missing/null/finite CIs unselected.
component_classification_rule: Only if CI of DAY coefficient is nominal negative and NIGHT CI includes zero, describe 'daytime-decline-consistent'; only if NIGHT CI nominal positive and DAY CI includes zero, 'nighttime-increase-consistent'; if both components nominally directional, describe both; never claim a mechanistic distinction merely from different statistical significance, and do not claim any direct behavioral thermoregulation. If neither source component excludes zero, mark component uncertainty although q CI may exclude zero.
inferential_unit: Independent original tagged animals within each original SOURCE study, not GPS intervals, days, months or 3 necessarily independent populations. No pooled global meta p-value.
